verdict.rationale: First-party docs show model choice across many providers: BYOK keys for Claude, GPT, Gemini, Kimi, Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM and MiniMax; self-hosted models via Ollama, LM Studio and OpenAI-compatible endpoints; and a managed library of pre-configured models. Providers are configured independently, many API styles are supported (Anthropic, Google, Azure, Bedrock, Vertex), and each parallel agent session can use a different model. The free Hobby tier is limited to 3 standard models, but BYOK sidesteps this. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the model-selection workflow.
